outcome: Return to health facility for postnatal care (PNC) use after giving birth at a health facility
cohort: 2405 mothers who gave birth in a health facility in Ethiopia
finding: Facility-based PNC utilization among mothers who delivered at health facilities is low in Ethiopia, and factors such as employment status, number of antenatal care visits, mode of delivery, and residence were found to be associated with PNC use.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was significantly associated with returning to health facilities for PNC use.
